preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in stdin.splitlines()[0])
preconditions.description: The first line of input (string a) contains only characters '0' and '1'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in stdin.splitlines()[1])
preconditions.description: The second line of input (string b) contains only characters '0' and '1'.
The first line of input (string a) is not empty.
The second line of input (string b) is not empty.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if sorted(stdin.splitlines()[0]) == sorted(stdin.splitlines()[1]) else return_value == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if and only if the sorted characters of string a are the same as the sorted characters of string b.
